title: Daniel in the lions' den — Wikipedia

verification_log.method: Tales of chs. 1–6 originally independent folktales of the Persian and Hellenistic periods (Collins 1984); collected mid-2nd century BC (Seow 2003); chs. 4–6 differ markedly in the oldest texts (Redditt 2008); closest parallel is Daniel 3 (Seow 2003); no discussion of satrapy counts, Persian law or lion-keeping
